yourData.title: Your data
yourData.signedOut: Sign in to see what the shop holds about you.
yourData.failed: That could not be done now. Try again in a moment.
yourData.downloadTitle: See what the shop holds about you
yourData.downloadWhat: One file, JSON: your account, addresses, the cards' labels (never the card), what you have looked at, your consents with their dates, and your orders.
yourData.forgottenWhat: Your addresses, your saved cards (our payment provider forgets them first), what you have looked at, your preferences and consents.
yourData.keptTitle: Kept, and used for nothing else
yourData.keptWhat: Your orders and the addresses they went to, for six years, because the law requires a shop to keep its invoices. They are no longer linked to your account or your sign-in; each still shows whom it was sent to, as an invoice must.
yourData.notOursWhat: Your sign-in (name, email, password) is held by your sign-in provider; manage or remove it there.
yourData.cannotBeUndone: This cannot be undone. You can still shop as a guest, or sign in again later as a new customer.
yourData.removedForgotten: Your addresses, saved cards, browsing history and preferences are gone.
yourData.removedKept: Your orders are kept for {{years}} years, as the law requires, and used for nothing else.
yourData.removedSignIn: Signing in again will start a new account. Your sign-in itself is your sign-in provider's.
